### Issues
**[R9-1][MEDIUM][statement-contradiction][HIGH]** Direct-path collision lacks precedence over rows 6/7/9/15
File: spec:51, :54, :60, :65, :72, :94
Issue: row 20 is gated "shape ok"; carrier-failure/select-present/aggregate rows are gated earlier and all order "P" — a bridge write of `mcp_bridge_projection` into the same SC (`direct_execution.go:60-64` keeps upstream's decoded map). Counterexample: matching direct call, upstream SC `{"result":"not-a-list","mcp_bridge_projection":{"v":1,"applied":true,…}}` → row 6 wins and the write overwrites upstream's member, contradicting C4b:72 ("collision ⇒ row 20; no bridge payload write"), :75 ("collisions never corrupt or overwrite upstream data"), F1's "no overwrite exception exists", and AC6's misattribution fail clause; applying C4b instead falsifies row 20's "shape ok" gate, replaces the row's reason, and breaks AC6(d)'s "(rows 6/7/9/15)" P claim. T1's 21-ro…
Fix: state precedence once — on the direct path, presence of the reserved key suppresses the bridge payload write on EVERY row (5/6/7/9/13/14/15), the colliding value passes verbatim, and the disclosure surfaces on M with that row's reason when a render occurs, else L+C; or drop row 20's "shape ok" gate and let `disclosure_key_collision` override those rows. Add T1/T2 oracles for carrier-failure+collision and select-present+collision.

**[R9-2][MEDIUM][statement-contradiction][HIGH]** "BYTE-IDENTICAL to the upstream's" is unachievable
File: spec:89, :152 (also :106)
Issue: the multiplexer embeds `upstream_result` via `rawValue(envelope.UpstreamResult)` (`tools.go:1047-1052`; `rawValue` :1339), which decodes to any/UseNumber and re-marshals; the direct path assigns the decoded SC (:60-64) and `deliverBoundedResult` re-marshals (`bounded_delivery.go:19`). Go sorts keys and strips whitespace, so delivered bytes match upstream bytes only by coincidence — the same class as the original F1 defect.
Fix: "value-identical — no member added, removed, or modified, compared as decoded JSON — and byte-identical to today's delivered result for the same payload"; pin the oracle as decoded-value equality; reword T2:106.

**[R9-3][LOW][spec-gap][MEDIUM]** Non-object upstream SC on the direct path has no authorized disclosure target
File: spec:72, :51, :94
Issue: C4b authorizes only "absent-upstream-SC replacement". If upstream SC is a JSON array/string, no member can be added, yet P orders a write; the only move replaces the whole SC, discarding upstream data.
Fix: state that a non-object SC is replaced by the reserved-member object (payload retained in Content), or mark P not applicable on that shape and pin M/L+C.
